<description>
Part of #36833

This PR adds local tracking of recent stale tips for [BIP 332](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0332.md).
The feature is behind a new `-staletips=<mode>` option (default `none`). There is no P2P change yet: with `-staletips=headers` the node only tracks tips.

### Key changes

* A new `AcceptedStaleTip` validation notification feeds the staletips tracker.
* The tracker is built from the block index at startup, keeping the tips with the most work.
  *  At most 10 tips are tracked. When the tracker is full, a new tip evicts the one with the least work, but only if the new tip has more work.
* `getchaintips` RPC updates
  * Add new options `max_depth` and `staletips_only`
  * Report `fork_point` for each non-active tip.

Test networks get the stricter policies the BIP recommends:
* **signet:** only tips whose block has been validated, and one header variant per block.
* **testnet3/4:** only tips with a difficulty of at least about 1,000,000.

Sample output (regtest, after a reorg replaced the tip at height 111)

```
$ bitcoin-cli getchaintips
[
  {
    "height": 112,
    "hash": "544a1c7f23c96990e2db9f4415f498d1ee61effac8e7416ec53fb91f538b2d2c",
    "branchlen": 0,
    "status": "active"
  },
  {
    "height": 111,
    "hash": "3a0797803400d80abdbf34f73df33f760c1e24696531746f975e3041055b6967",
    "branchlen": 1,
    "fork_point": "43765e057b6cde12df1701595d90ae51cf80490fef1343edd2d3fbe2edf3958e",
    "status": "valid-fork"
  }
]

$ bitcoin-cli -named getchaintips staletips_only=true
[
  {
    "height": 111,
    "hash": "3a0797803400d80abdbf34f73df33f760c1e24696531746f975e3041055b6967",
    "branchlen": 1,
    "fork_point": "43765e057b6cde12df1701595d90ae51cf80490fef1343edd2d3fbe2edf3958e",
    "status": "valid-fork"
  }
]
```
</description>

<commits>
97512c7963 validation: add AcceptedStaleTip notification

Notify validation interface listeners when a header or block is
accepted that is not on the active chain and has no more work than
the active tip. BIP 332 stale-tip tracking, added in later commits,
uses this.

Headers from one ProcessNewBlockHeaders() call are coalesced into one
notification for the last new header. A block is notified again when
its data is stored.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

d567ff5de9 staletips: add bounded stale-tip tracker

Add StaleTipTracker, which keeps up to MAX_ADVERTISED_STALETIPS
recent stale tips that are eligible for relay under BIP 332. When
full, it evicts the tip with the least work.

Add BlockTree to test/util/blocktree.h so later tests can share it.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

00660cb87a staletips: apply test-network tracking policies

Test networks are less protected by proof of work, so BIP 332
recommends stricter stale-tip policies there. On signet, only track
tips whose block has been validated, and one header variant per
block. On testnet3 and testnet4, only track tips with a difficulty
of at least about 1,000,000.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

01f8a8f8f3 staletips: seed tracker from the block index

The tracker is not persisted, so add SeedFromBlockIndex() to rebuild
it at startup from the eligible stale tips in the block index.
Candidates go through AddStaleTip(), so the same policies apply as
at runtime.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

c497ae1291 init: add -staletips option

Add -staletips=<mode> to opt in to BIP 332 stale-tip relay. For now
'headers' only enables stale-tip tracking, which the next commits
add; later PRs add relay behind the same mode.

Make the PeerManager ApplyArgsManOptions() return util::Result, like
the other ApplyArgsManOptions() helpers, so an invalid mode is
reported at startup.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

9cf113f3cc net_processing: track local stale tips

When -staletips is enabled, track the stale tips this node learns
about.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

61c349f95a rpc: add max_depth and fork_point to getchaintips

Add an optional max_depth argument that limits getchaintips to tips at
most that many blocks below the active tip, and report fork_point for
each tip that is not on the active chain.

This lets callers find recent forks without listing every old stale
branch on mainnet or walking back each branch to its fork point.

4173d9332c rpc: report tracked stale tips in getchaintips

Add a staletips_only argument to getchaintips that lists only the
recent stale tips the node tracks with -staletips, taken from the
stale-tip tracker.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

10fa8b7a08 doc: add release note for stale-tip tracking
</commits>

+New settings
+------------
+
+- A new `-staletips=<mode>` option tracks recent stale chain tips for
+  stale-tip relay (BIP 332). The modes are `none` (the default) and
+  `headers`. (#36919)
+
+Updated RPCs
+------------
+
+- `getchaintips` has a new optional `options` argument. Its `max_depth`
+  option limits the result to tips at most that many blocks below the
+  active tip, and its `staletips_only` option lists only the recent stale
+  tips tracked with `-staletips`. The options can also be passed as named
+  arguments. (#36919)
+
+- `getchaintips` reports `fork_point`, the block where the branch
+  connects to the active chain, for each non-active tip. (#36919)

+/** Options for the test blocks built by MakeHeader() and BlockTree::Add(). */
+struct BlockTreeAddOptions {
+    //! Mark the block as stored and validated up to BLOCK_VALID_TRANSACTIONS.
+    bool have_data{false};
+    uint32_t bits{0x1d00ffff};
+    //! Merkle root of the header, or a value unique to the block if unset.
+    std::optional<uint256> merkle_root{};
+};
+
+/** Build a header on `prev` whose hash is unique for each `nonce`. */
+inline CBlockHeader MakeHeader(const CBlockIndex* prev, uint32_t nonce, const BlockTreeAddOptions& opts)
+{
+    CBlockHeader header;
+    header.nVersion = 4;
+    header.hashPrevBlock = prev ? prev->GetBlockHash() : uint256::ZERO;
+    header.hashMerkleRoot = opts.merkle_root.value_or(uint256{static_cast<uint8_t>(nonce)});
+    header.nTime = 1'700'000'000 + nonce;
+    header.nBits = opts.bits;
+    header.nNonce = nonce;
+    return header;
+}
+
+/** Block index entries linked into a tree without a BlockManager, for unit
+ *  tests of code that walks the block index. */
+struct BlockTree
+{
+    //! A deque so phashBlock pointers stay valid as blocks are added.
+    std::deque<uint256> hashes;
+    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<CBlockIndex>> blocks;
+    CChain active_chain;
+    uint32_t next_nonce{1};
+
+    /** Add a block on top of `prev`, or a genesis block if `prev` is null.
+     *  If `active`, make it the active tip. */
+    CBlockIndex* Add(CBlockIndex* prev, bool active, BlockTreeAddOptions opts = {}) EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED(::cs_main)
+    {
+        const CBlockHeader header{MakeHeader(prev, next_nonce++, opts)};
+
+        hashes.push_back(header.GetHash());
+        auto block{std::make_unique<CBlockIndex>(header)};
+        block->phashBlock = &hashes.back();
+        block->pprev = prev;
+        block->nHeight = prev ? prev->nHeight + 1 : 0;
+        block->nChainWork = (prev ? prev->nChainWork : arith_uint256{}) + arith_uint256{1};
+        block->nStatus = BLOCK_VALID_TREE;
+        if (opts.have_data) {
+            block->RaiseValidity(BLOCK_VALID_TRANSACTIONS);
+            block->nStatus |= BLOCK_HAVE_DATA;
+        }
+        block->BuildSkip();
+        CBlockIndex* ret{block.get()};
+        blocks.push_back(std::move(block));
+        if (active) active_chain.SetTip(*ret);
+        return ret;
+    }
+
+    /** Add a genesis block and `height` more blocks on top of it, all on the
+     *  active chain, and return the tip. */
+    CBlockIndex* AddChain(int height, BlockTreeAddOptions opts = {}) EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED(::cs_main)
+    {
+        CBlockIndex* tip{Add(nullptr, /*active=*/true, opts)};
+        for (int i{0}; i < height; ++i) tip = Add(tip, /*active=*/true, opts);
+        return tip;
+    }
